brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called for the formation of a unity government in a video statement released Monday, describing it as an "absolute necessity," Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu did not specify which parties or figures he considered "Hamas supporters" in his statement.

The call came as Netanyahu sought to build broader political consensus, though his framing of potential coalition partners created immediate divisions over which Israeli political groups could be included in any such arrangement.
dek: Netanyahu calls for unity government without 'Hamas supporters' In a video statement released on Monday, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said forming a unity government was an "absolute necessity".
title: Netanyahu demands unity government excluding 'Hamas supporters'
